title: Ox Passion Cherry Fizz Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Cherry Fizz offers nostalgic and refreshing taste of classic Cherry Soda. The sugary, sweet flavour of cherry swirled into bubbly soda makes for a truly playful and indulgent all-day vape. Blended in a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, offering a smooth throat hit with well-defined flavour. Perfect for pod vape kits and starter devices, it provides rapid nicotine absorption for a consistently satisfying vape experience. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts range features expertly crafted flavours designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
